title: He went to school in Delhi. Now he runs one of America's biggest phone companies.

sources.text: The Tribune - Indian-American Executive Named T-Mobile CEO
NewsGram - T-Mobile appoints Indian-origin Srini Gopalan as new CEO

caption:
He went to school in Delhi. Now he runs one of America's biggest phone companies.

Born and raised in Delhi, he attended Delhi Public School and St. Stephen's College before earning his MBA from IIM Ahmedabad - then built a career spanning Hindustan Unilever, Vodafone, Bharti Airtel and CEO of Deutsche Telekom Germany before taking the top job at T-Mobile.

From COO to CEO at T-Mobile, Gopalan's path runs through Indian, European and American corporate cultures - a career built on moving between markets, not staying in one.

Gopalan's path is a reminder that India's management training pipeline - IIM included - is already producing leaders for companies far beyond India's borders.
